name: Celebrating Christmas
overview: Scripture reveals that the celebration of Christmas centers on the miraculous birth of Jesus Christ, foretold by the prophet Isaiah as the virgin-born Immanuel, God with us, who carries the government on His shoulders and bears titles such as Wonderful Counselor and Prince of Peace. The joy and gladness surrounding His birth, as announced in Luke, invite believers to rejoice in the coming of the righteous and humble King prophesied in Zechariah. At the same time, Jeremiah warns against adopting pagan customs, emphasizing that true celebration honors the unique salvation brought through the Messiah, the Branch from Jesse's line.
